pose: Full body side profile. A compact, muscular Oviraptor with a distinctive high, rounded head crest and a short, deep, curved beak. It is standing in a confident, alert pose. The hands feature long, slender fingers with curved claws. Soulful eyes and a charismatic, knowing smirk. Vibrant, colorful plumage covering the body with fan-like feathers on the tail and forearms. 1:1 square framing.
